metadata.description: Limited-repeat strong-wind adapter comparison for Stage 4-H risk_adapter_v1 evaluation.
metadata.repeat_policy: Trial 4, Trial 5, and Trial 6 have been expanded to 10 repeats for original, fixed_s085, windlevel_s085, and risk_adapter_v1.
metadata.limitations: Simulation-only, limited-repeat evidence; not a statistical robustness proof. The main four methods now support a balanced 30-repeat Trial 4/5/6 comparison.
metadata.manual_observation_note: Trial 4 includes manual visual observations of obstacle-collision/path-feasibility-related failures; some invalids may not be purely command-adaptation or risk-prediction failures.
metadata.label_convention: Paper-facing comparison should use strict-valid / label_strict_invalid interpretation because valid_run_suggested can overestimate safety success when swing or payload-speed thresholds are exceeded.
metadata.balanced_aggregate_note: Main four-method Trial 4/5/6 aggregate: original 18/30, fixed_s085 18/30, windlevel_s085 16/30, risk_adapter_v1 23/30.

results.notes: Trial 4 expanded to 10 repeats; invalid repeats were target-error failures. Manual visual observations indicate some Trial 4 invalids may involve obstacle-collision/path-feasibility interaction.

Trial 4 expanded to 10 repeats; best Trial 4 method. One invalid repeat was a NaN failure. Manual visual observations indicate some Trial 4 invalids may involve obstacle-collision/path-feasibility interaction.

Trial 4 expanded to 10 repeats; invalids include many NaN failures and one target-error/high-swing case. Manual visual observations indicate some Trial 4 invalids may involve obstacle-collision/path-feasibility interaction.

Trial 4 expanded to 10 repeats; repeat5 and repeat9 were late-risk NaN/safety failures, and repeat7 was a target-error failure. Manual visual observations indicate some Trial 4 invalids may involve obstacle-collision/path-feasibility interaction.

Trial 5 expanded to 10 repeats; strict-valid count is 7/10 while valid_run_suggested is 9/10. repeat1 was a NaN/safety failure; repeat4 and repeat8 were strict safety failures despite valid_run_suggested=true.
Trial 5 expanded to 10 repeats; invalids include NaN, swing/speed, and target-related failures.
Trial 5 expanded to 10 repeats; invalids include target-error and NaN failures.
Trial 5 expanded to 10 repeats; strongest Trial 5 method. repeat6 was a NaN/safety failure. Trial 4/5/6 main-method balanced 10-repeat comparison is now available after Trial 6 expansion.

Trial 6 expanded to 10 repeats; strict-valid and raw valid_run_suggested are both 3/10. Failures are mostly state_divergence_before_command_nan, with NaN/divergence mechanisms mixed with saturation diagnostics.
Trial 6 expanded to 10 repeats; strict-valid and raw valid_run_suggested are both 4/10. Failures are mostly command_saturation_before_nan, with one no-NaN strict safety / target failure.
Trial 6 expanded to 10 repeats; strict-valid and raw valid_run_suggested are both 6/10. Results include command_saturation_before_nan failures and valid command_saturation_without_divergence cases.

Trial 6 expanded to 10 repeats; strict-valid and raw valid_run_suggested are both 7/10. Strongest Trial 6 method, but failures include state_divergence_before_command_nan and reference_jump_before_command_nan.
